baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction from seeing, through striking a similitude, to a good word like a good tree.
baseline_models.mechanism: The divine depiction converts an intelligible utterance into an inspectable living form. Repeated goodness aligns the quality of the word with the quality of its arboreal embodiment, joining semantic worth to viable growth.

activation_trace.role: Sensory or inward seeing supplies inspection and makes the comparison something to examine.
Depicting and displaying a similitude supplies the conversion of speech into a visible model.
A struck, circulating similitude supplies the formal bridge between word and tree.
A meaningful expression supplies the verbal entity whose behavior the tree renders.
Goodness opposed to corruption qualifies both word and tree and locks their values together.
The stemmed plant supplies a living architecture rather than a merely verbal resemblance.

changed_reading.before: A favorable saying receives a decorative comparison to a pleasant tree.
changed_reading.after: A meaningful word is made inspectable as a living system whose goodness must appear as viable structure and growth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Its origin is fixed while its branch is in the sky.
baseline_models.mechanism: A foundational lower element persists while an upper element emerges and rises from it. Fixity and ascent are complementary functions: durable attachment enables expansive reach.

activation_trace.role: The base and lowest foundation supply the system's anchoring element.
Persistence against removal supplies temporal and spatial continuity at the base.
A high branch emerging from an origin supplies outward and upward extension.
Height and elevation supply the branch's open upper domain and visible reach.

changed_reading.before: The image separately praises a firm root and a tall branch.
changed_reading.after: The word works through a vertical mechanism in which deep continuity is what makes elevated extension possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence word, tree, origin, and branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tree can denote an originating stock, while the branch is an offshoot from that stock. Joined to speech that connects speakers, the good word can found a lineage of related expressions or bearers without losing its originating identity.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the transmissible relation.
Tree as blessed origin or figurative stock supplies a lineage-bearing center.
Deep provenance and rooted standing supply continuity of identity.
Offshoots and descendants emerging from an origin supply multiplication across linked branches.

changed_reading.before: The tree gives one word a stable individual shape.
changed_reading.after: The word can be an originating stock that generates a related lineage of speakers, expressions, or consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The word enters a delivery chain: organized writing is sent down, articulated in a people's language, clarified, and finally designated a communication. The focus tree therefore joins two directions: the message descends into intelligible local form, takes root, and extends upward and outward.

activation_trace.role: The meaningful expression supplies the payload that moves through the communication chain.
The high emerging branch supplies the message's expanding reach after reception.
Organized letters and the written object supply a durable verbal body.
Sending down and delivering supplies the first vertical movement of the word.
Language and speech locate the delivered word in a community's own idiom.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies intelligibility as the condition for rooting.
Conveying a message to its destination supplies the completed communicative arc.

structural_cues: 14:1 frames the written message as bringing people from darkness to light.
14:4 binds every messenger to the language of his people.
14:52 names the whole address a communication for people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, descent, vernacular language, clarification, and delivery; I supply the arrow that intelligibility lets the word take root and branch. A live alternative is that the tree marks the word's quality without modeling transmission.

changed_reading.before: The good word is already present as an isolated true utterance.
changed_reading.after: The good word is a delivered, localized, intelligible message whose rooted reception enables expanding reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gratitude is answered by increase, and the tree later gives its yield at every fitting time under permission. The good word can therefore operate as a regenerative response: acknowledgment becomes fresh growth, growth becomes recurring fruit, and fruit remains authorized rather than self-produced.

activation_trace.role: The stemmed plant supplies the organism in which increase can become yield.
The emergence of a fresh shoot supplies a vegetative image for gratitude's response.
Increase and growth supply the explicit expansion caused after gratitude.
The yield of tree and crop supplies the recurring output of the good word.
An appointed occasion supplies recurrence without requiring constant visible production.
Permission supplies the governing authorization under which fruit appears.

structural_cues: 14:5 pairs signs with intensive patience and gratitude.
14:7 states the gratitude-to-increase conditional.
14:25 gives the tree's yield repeatedly and by its Lord's permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the gratitude-to-increase arrow and timed fruit under permission; I map increase onto the tree's growth and yield. A live alternative is that the fruit covers consequences of good speech generally, not gratitude specifically.

changed_reading.before: Goodness is a stable quality possessed by the word.
changed_reading.after: Goodness is regenerative: a grateful response grows into authorized, repeatedly renewed benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messengers are threatened with removal from the land, yet are promised settlement in it. Botanical fixity becomes communal persistence through displacement: being rooted does not require never being moved geographically; it means that coercive expulsion cannot terminate the word-bearing community.

activation_trace.role: The stemmed tree supplies the vulnerable but living body exposed to removal.
The foundational base supplies continuity deeper than present location.
Persistence against removal supplies the community's survival through pressure.
Passage to the outside supplies the coercive threat of uprooting.
Ground opposed to sky supplies the contested medium of rooted residence.
Settling into a dwelling supplies restored emplacement after attempted expulsion.

structural_cues: 14:12 places patient endurance immediately before the expulsion threat.
14:13 threatens the messengers with expulsion from the land.
14:14 answers with promised settlement in the land after the oppressors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion and counter-settlement; I map those social events onto botanical rooting and treat persistence as continuity through relocation. A live alternative is that the fixed root denotes inward doctrinal steadiness only.

changed_reading.before: A fixed root means remaining physically undisturbed in one place.
changed_reading.after: A fixed root means continuity that survives coercive removal and can be re-established without losing identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposing similitude turns works into fire-remnant ash seized by a violent wind until their earners retain no command over them. The fixed root now preserves the relation between action and result: the good word has an architecture capable of carrying its effects into fruit instead of losing them to dispersal.

activation_trace.role: The foundation supplies retained connection between source and later result.
Persistence against disappearance supplies resistance to dispersal.
Ash left by burning supplies output with no cohesive productive structure.
Moving wind supplies the medium that carries unsupported residue away.
A violent wind that lightens and scatters things supplies the destructive force.
Acquired gain supplies the action-to-result relation that the ash image fails to preserve.

structural_cues: 14:18 is itself a similitude and explicitly denies control over anything earned.
14:19 repeats the visual summons before describing creation with truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies works-as-ash, violent dispersal, and lost command over earnings; I infer that rootedness preserves action-to-fruit continuity. A live alternative is that the contrast concerns eschatological value alone rather than a general memory mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Rootedness is anti-dispersal memory: it keeps a word connected to the benefits it can later bear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Followers seek rescue from leaders, while the deceiving caller denies coercive authority and distinguishes his call from their response. Branching can therefore model accountable uptake: a word extends through hearers who answer it, but the source does not mechanically own every branch's choice.

activation_trace.role: Speech linking speakers supplies the initiating interpersonal call.
Multiple offshoots from an origin supply the network of downstream respondents.
Following behind another supplies social dependence within the branching network.
A compelling proof or authority, here denied, marks the limit of the caller's control.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the non-coercive initiating act.
Answering speech supplies the hearer's distinct act that completes transmission.

structural_cues: 14:21 stages followers trying to transfer the consequences of following to their leaders.
14:22 separates invitation, response, authority, and self-blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, a call, an answer, and denied authority; I map those roles onto origin and branches. A live alternative is that the branch indicates only the word's reach, not the agency of its hearers.

changed_reading.before: A good word propagates by the force of its source alone.
changed_reading.after: A word branches through accountable responses: rooted truth can spread without erasing the agency of those who receive it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrary word-tree is removed whole from its origin and lacks any resting stability; the next ayah then makes the fixed saying the means by which God stabilizes believers in both temporal domains. The arboreal image becomes operative: the word does not merely possess stability but transmits it to its bearers.

activation_trace.role: The meaningful expression supplies the instrument later restated as a saying.
Enduring fixity supplies the property that can be communicated to persons.
Corruption opposed to goodness supplies the controlled reversal of both word and tree.
Removal of the whole thing from its root supplies total loss of causal attachment.
Settlement and stability, here absent, supply the failed condition of the corrupt word.
Spoken saying supplies the explicit verbal counterpart to the focus word.
Making something firm and strengthening the heart supplies the transfer of fixity from saying to believer.

structural_cues: 14:26 repeats word and tree while reversing their quality and removing the root.
14:27 shifts from pictured fixity to God's stabilization of believers by the fixed saying.
14:27 spans worldly life and the hereafter, extending fixity across temporal domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies the fixed saying as the means of divine stabilization; I map that action back onto the tree's root mechanics. A live alternative is to leave the tree illustrative and treat 14:27 as a separate application.

changed_reading.before: The word is an object that happens to be stable.
changed_reading.after: The word is a stabilizing instrument through which its bearers are made persistent across changing domains.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant focus branch associates the sky-root with first rain marking earth by plants; later, water descends from the sky and fruits emerge as provision. The vertical tree can thus be read as a circulation interface: upper exposure receives descending provision, rooted life converts it, and fruit returns it to the social world.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with plants supplies the exploratory rain-growth image within the split sky inventory.
The high branch supplies the exposed upper interface of the circulation.
Delivery downward supplies the direction from sky toward rooted life.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation supplies the material transferred through the system.
Ripe fruit supplies the transformed output of sky, water, and rooted growth.
An apportioned gift supplies the social destination of the tree's material output.

structural_cues: 14:32 explicitly sequences sky, descending water, emerging fruits, and provision.
14:37 places descendants in a valley without cultivation and asks for fruits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the split rain-marking branch and the water-to-fruit sequence; I supply the arrow that the skyward branch functions as an interface in that circulation. A live alternative is that its place in the sky denotes height alone.

changed_reading.before: The branch is in the sky only to signal extreme height.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the skyward branch places the word-tree inside a descending-water and returning-fruit circulation of provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prayer sequence repeatedly joins children, descendants, gifted sons, parents, worship, and petition. The focus word-tree becomes a transgenerational speech lineage: prayer is rooted in one speaker yet branches into descendants who continue its orientation.

activation_trace.role: Tree as figurative origin or stock supplies the genealogical center.
Offshoots and children from an origin supply intergenerational extension.
Speech connecting speakers supplies prayer as the transmissible organizing relation.
Sonship, lineage, and relation to an origin supply the first named family branch.
Small particles spreading supply a branch image for descendants dispersed from one source.
A gift given without exchange supplies the arrival of sons as granted continuation.
Parents viewed through birth supply the backward link of the same lineage.

structural_cues: 14:35-41 repeatedly moves among sons, descendants, parents, and prayer.
14:37 places the descendants in a barren valley yet asks for worship and fruit.
14:40 asks that the speaker and part of his descendants maintain prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies children, descendants, gifted sons, parents, and repeated prayer; I map the origin and branch structure onto transmission across generations. A live alternative is a non-genealogical community of belief.

changed_reading.before: The word-tree describes one speaker's settled conviction.
changed_reading.after: The word can be a rooted prayer that branches through generations and organizes continuity beyond its first speaker.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the wound branch of the word-root beside the impact branch of striking. It remains anchored in the focus's own roots and gains coherence from purification and evidentiary fixity, but downstream prose must label it a lexical cross-branch experiment, not claim that the ayah denotes bodily injury.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of striking, word, goodness, and fixity.

activation_trace.role: Impact of one thing upon another supplies the word's forceful contact.
A bodily wound supplies the strange image of speech leaving a consequential incision or mark.
Purification from filth supplies a wholesome rather than destructive consequence.
Proof and establishment supply the lasting evidentiary mark left by the impact.

changed_reading.before: A good word is necessarily soft and non-disruptive.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a good word may strike like a salutary incision whose lasting mark clears and establishes rather than destroys.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the tree-root opens onto tangled dispute and a branch that restrains opponents. It remains valid through four mutually reinforcing focus branches, but downstream prose should present it as an overlay about disciplined contested speech, not replace the primary botanical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-tree's speech, entanglement, fixed tongue, and restraining branch.

activation_trace.role: Mutually intelligible speech supplies the field in which disagreement is conducted.
Entangled dispute and mixed speech supply the contested social environment.
Steadiness of heart, reason, and tongue in dispute supplies disciplined verbal footing.
Restraining and separating pushing opponents supplies a conflict-regulating branch function.

changed_reading.before: The good tree pictures speech in a tranquil environment.
changed_reading.after: The good word can be disciplined conflict architecture: steady speech that enters entanglement yet checks collision and preserves relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's plot-root inventory preserves a watering-cultivation branch beside a scheme said to move mountains. It remains anchored by the focus tree, goodness, and fixity and warns that growth imagery alone does not establish goodness; downstream prose must qualify it as a form-distant counter-cultivation activation and not derive plotting from irrigation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The good tree and its fixed root set against the cultivated branch activated by the mountain-moving plot.

activation_trace.role: Goodness opposed to corruption supplies the ethical discriminator between kinds of growth.
The living tree supplies the cultivation domain under comparison.
Persistence against removal supplies the good tree's stable contrast.
Watering land and crop supplies the form-distant image of a scheme being deliberately cultivated.
Removal from place or state supplies the plot's intended destabilizing effect.
A high solid mass supplies the extreme object that cultivated plotting would dislodge.

changed_reading.before: Anything cultivated, extensive, and persistent shares the good tree's value.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, schemes too can be imagined as cultivated systems, so goodness and divinely sustained fruit, not growth alone, distinguish the focus tree.

strongest_changes: The tree becomes a communication system joining descent into language, rooted intelligibility, and expanding reach.
The gratitude-to-increase sequence and recurring yield make goodness regenerative rather than merely descriptive.
Expulsion and counter-settlement recast fixity as continuity through displacement, not immobility.
The ash-and-wind contrast makes the root preserve action-to-fruit continuity against dispersal.
The immediate contrary tree and fixed saying turn the word from a stable object into an instrument that stabilizes people.
The later family prayers activate a transgenerational lineage of rooted speech.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly moved the focus word across communicative, ecological, social, and genealogical mechanisms without severing its roots in the focus construction. The split sky inventory produced the rare but packet-supported possibility of rain-marked circulation, while the wound, dispute, and counter-cultivation branches remained live only under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the branch in the sky functions only as height or also as a rain-facing interface.
Whether the lineage mechanism is primarily genealogical or extends to a non-biological community of belief.
Whether branching legitimately models accountable hearer responses or only the reach of the word's effects.
How far the wound, conflict, and cultivated-plot outliers can enter prose without overstating branch-level wordplay.
